proposal.summary: Path traversal in the file download endpoint of NimbusDocs allows unauthorized access to sensitive files.
proposal.cwe_quote: Path Traversal: The application does not properly sanitize user input, allowing attackers to access files outside the intended directory.

AV.quote: Path traversal in the file download endpoint of NimbusDocs lets me read /etc/passwd.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate and patch the file download endpoint to prevent path traversal attacks.
